subject: Support coverage, escalation matrix and incident comms — questionnaire response
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme-fin.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: 2027-02-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: RFP — support coverage & incident comms (section 4)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for making time to review our support section of the RFP. Procurement and Security asked me to collect a few concrete artifacts:

- A description of TAM / customer success coverage (hours, role responsibilities, escalation tiers and contact matrix).
- Example incident communication templates and an expected notification timeline for P1/P2 incidents.
- A proposed on-call calendar example and escalation response windows for 24/7 critical coverage.
- Any relevant runbook excerpts or references to monitoring and paging.

Attached is the support appendix from our RFP (Acme_RFP_Support_Appendix_v3.pdf). If you can provide a short companion packet (1–2 pages) and a calendar mock we can attach to the RFP response, that would be ideal.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood provides a named TAM for Dedicated customers and what the SLA is for initial incident response for a P1?

We are aiming to finalize the vendor shortlist by 2027-03-10, so if possible could we have draft materials by 2027-03-01?

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Senior Procurement Lead
Acme Financial

--
Attachment: Acme_RFP_Support_Appendix_v3.pdf (PDF, 124KB)

From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme-fin.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-28T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RFP — support coverage & incident comms (section 4)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the clear list and the appendix — we can absolutely provide the items you requested. I attached a draft packet that covers TAM coverage, our escalation matrix, and incident notification templates. High-level answers below; details are in the attachments.

- TAM / CS coverage: For Hosted customers, standard customer success coverage is 9:00–17:00 PT, Monday–Friday, assigned TAM during business hours. For Dedicated and Enterprise customers we offer named TAMs with an escalation path and optional extended coverage.
- 24/7 critical coverage: We provide 24/7 on-call for P1 (Critical) incidents for customers on Premier & Dedicated plans. That coverage is provided via a tiered on-call rotation (Tier 1 SRE -> Tier 2 Support Engineer -> Platform Engineering -> CS Leadership).
- Response targets: Initial acknowledgement for P1 is under 1 hour (during on-call), P2 initial response within 4 hours (business hours), full remediation targets depend on incident scope — see SLA table in the packet.
- Incident comms: Included are templates for initial acknowledgment, 30-minute status, and incident postmortem. The templates list what we include in each update (impact, scope, mitigation steps, ETA).
- Runbooks & monitoring: We include a short runbook excerpt showing alert paging rules and runbook owners; full runbooks are available under NDA or via our secure runbook portal.

Proposed next step: 30-minute discovery sync to walk through the packet and answer any additional questions. I can do Wednesday 2027-03-02 10:00 PT or Thursday 2027-03-03 09:00 PT — let me know what works for your team.

Attachments: Redwood_TAM_Coverage_Resp.docx; Incident_Notification_Templates.txt

Best regards,

Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Direct: (415) 555-01XX

--

Attachment: Incident_Notification_Templates.txt (TXT, 8KB)

Lauren — quick updates I pushed into the draft packet:

Hi Lauren / Marissa,

Thanks for the packet and the quick turnaround — we reviewed the draft. A couple of clarifying questions before we include it in our RFP response:

1) For the 24/7 P1 coverage you mentioned, can you confirm the exact "initial response" metric (is it <1 hour SLA or acknowledgement within 15 minutes?), and how that is measured?
2) What qualifies as a P1 for Acme? Can you share a short definition we can include (we have internal risk criteria).
3) For on-call escalation, do you provide public escalation phone numbers or a pager that Acme can call after-hours? We need an after-hours contact method in the submission.

Also, would you be able to move the discovery sync to Thursday 2027-03-03 at 11:00 PT instead of Wednesday? Procurement is tied up Wednesday morning.

Attaching our internal risk profile that lists example P1/P2 criteria (Acme_Risk_Profile.xlsx) for your reference.

Appreciate it — if you can reply with the short answers inline we can slot your packet into section 4 and move forward.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Senior Procurement Lead
Acme Financial

--

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the clarifying questions — answers inline below so you can paste into the RFP. We can take the sync on Thursday 2027-03-03 at 11:00 PT; I've sent a calendar invite to the procurement address you included.

1) Initial response SLA for 24/7 P1 coverage:
- Initial acknowledgement: target is < 1 hour from the issued pager/alert. For customers on Premier / Dedicated plans we operate to a measurable "first touch" metric (time ticket created -> first comment by on-call). In practice our median is ~20–30 minutes; SLA commitment in the contract is <1 hour.

2) P1 definition (suggested wording):
- P1 (Critical): Production outage or major degradation of Redwood inference serving that materially impacts transaction processing or customer-facing latency across a critical business flow. Examples: complete inability to generate responses for a core service path, data corruption affecting served outputs, or cascading failures that degrade more than X% of requests. (We can tailor the X% threshold to Acme risk criteria.)

3) After-hours contact method / escalation phone:
- We provide a dedicated on-call pager number and secure escalation line for Premier / Dedicated customers; phone numbers are shared once contracting is complete. For RFP purposes you can state: "24/7 on-call pager and secured escalation line provided for Premier/Dedicated customers; contact numbers provided at contracting."

Attachments included for the RFP packet: Redwood_Response_SLA_Table.csv (SLA targets and measurement windows) and Runbook_Excerpt.txt (alerting and runbook owners). See also the shared runbook portal link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Support-Runbooks/ACME-excerpt.

Next steps: 1) We will refine the P1 threshold based on Acme's X% impact number if you share it (we saw your risk profile). 2) Confirm the sync for Thu 2027-03-03 11:00 PT so Marissa/Karthik/Priyom can walk through the packet in 30 minutes.

If you'd like, we can also include a short example of the first 4 status updates (0m, 30m, 2h, 24h) as a timeline snippet in the RFP.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
